blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual interaction models that support users during ongoing physical tasks require evaluation in closed loop, where assistant responses can change subsequent user behavior and task outcomes. Existing benchmarks largely rely on offline replay and therefore cannot capture these effects. We introduce Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of executable task environments and human users. We contribute three simulators that recreate everyday tasks and human-aligned action spaces across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile-interface domains, together with a persona-conditioned user simulation harness that collaborates with the assistant while incorporating controlled execution errors and other out-of-plan behaviors. We instantiate the framework as IVG-Bench, a benchmark with 315 interaction scenarios. Evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models reveals substantial limitations: the best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, exhibits significant weaknesses in factual grounding and actionable guidance, and is often too slow to prevent errors when response latency is considered. We verify our evaluation protocol with a human study which finds 78.5% agreement between our interaction-quality metric and participant preferences. We further show that the environments provide useful learning signals: in a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment, closed-loop training improves both task success and interaction quality for Qwen3.5-4B model in our cooking environment.
blocks.zh: 在当前物理任务期间支持用户的视觉交互模型需要闭环评价,其中助理响应可以改变随后的用户行为和任务结果. 现有基准主要依靠离线重播,因此无法捕捉到这些影响。 我们通过联合模拟可执行的任务环境和人类用户,引入了互动视觉体格(Interactive Visual Gym),这是对视觉互动模型进行闭路评价和培训的框架. 我们贡献了三个模拟器,这些模拟器在烹饪、家庭操控和移动界面领域重新创造日常任务和人与人相配合的行动空间,以及一个与助理合作的个性化用户模拟工具,同时纳入可控执行错误和其他计划外行为。 我们以IVG-Bench为框架进行即时分析,这一基准有315种互动情景。 将最新水平的VLM作为视觉交互模型来评价,揭示了巨大的局限性:表现最好的模型双子座4Argon,在时限内只完成了53.4%的任务,在事实基础和可操作的引导上表现出显著的弱点,而且往往过于缓慢,无法在考虑反应延迟时防止错误. 我们用一项人类研究来验证我们的评估协议,该研究发现我们互动质量的衡量和参与者偏好之间有78.5%的一致. 我们进一步表明,这些环境提供了有益的学习信号:在概念证明GRPO实验中,闭路训练提高了我们烹饪环境中Quen3.5-4B模型的任务成功和互动质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Building systems that collaborate effectively with people is a longstanding goal of interactive machine learning ( Amershi et al., 2014 ) . Recent advances in LLM agents have enabled collaboration on digital tasks, including web research and software development, through dialogue, preference adaptation, and coordinated action ( Shao et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . More recently, extending such collaboration to everyday physical tasks has drawn growing interest, motivating visual interaction models that observe a video stream of a user’s ongoing activities and provide guidance ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Thinking Machines Lab, 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . For example, an assistant monitoring a procedural physical task like cooking can help plan the next step, detect execution errors, and guide recovery if a mistake happens.
blocks.zh: 建立与人民有效协作的系统是互动机器学习的长期目标(Amershi等,2014年)。 最近LLM代理商的进步使得通过对话、优惠适应和协调行动等数字任务的合作得以进行,包括网络研究和软件开发(Shao等人,2026;Sun等人,2026)。 最近,将这种协作扩大到日常的物理任务,引起了越来越多的兴趣,激发了视觉互动模型,这些模型观察一个用户正在进行的活动的视频流,并提供指导(Cui等,2026;思维机器实验室,2026;姚等,2026)。 例如,一个助理监督一个程序物理任务,如烹饪,可以帮助规划下一步,发现执行错误,并在出错时指导恢复.

blocks.en: Developing and evaluating interactive agents requires closed-loop rollouts that capture how each interaction changes subsequent user behavior and environment state, enabling assessment of its contribution to task completion. For digital agents, existing websites and software provide readily available tasks and executable environments, which can be paired with simulated users to support such rollouts ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2026 ) . Building an equivalent testbed for visual assistance is substantially more difficult. First, physical tasks and their environments are not readily available in a digital form; they must be reconstructed with visual observations, underlying world state, and an action space that supports human task execution. Second, visual assistance places substantially greater demands on user simulation. In most digital settings, the model executes actions while the user primarily clarifies goals and preferences. In physical activities, the user is the acting agent, and the model influences execution through communication. The simulated user must plan, act, make plausible mistakes, while interpreting guidance and deciding how to respond. These simulation challenges have limited visual interaction model training and evaluation to replaying recorded interactions and matching reference responses ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Kundu et al., 2026 ; Ran et al., 2026 ) , where the user’s actions and responses remain unchanged regardless of the assistant’s guidance.
blocks.zh: 开发和评价交互式代理商需要封闭式启动,以了解每次互动如何改变随后的用户行为和环境状态,从而能够评估其对完成任务的贡献。 对于数字代理,现有网站和软件提供现成的任务和可执行环境,可以与模拟用户对接以支持这种推出(周等,2024;姚等,2024;邵等,2026.). 建造同等的视觉辅助试验台要困难得多。 首先,实际任务及其环境不易以数字形式获得;必须用视觉观测、基本的世界状态和支持人类任务执行的行动空间来重建。 第二,视觉协助对用户模拟的要求大得多。 在大多数数字环境下,模型执行动作,而用户主要澄清目标和偏好. 在物理活动中,用户是代理,模型通过沟通影响执行. 模拟用户必须计划、行动、犯可信的错误,同时解释指南和决定如何应对。 这些模拟挑战的视觉交互模型培训和评价有限,无法重放所记录的交互和匹配的参考响应(Liu等,2026;Kundu等,2026;Ran等,2026),无论助理的指导如何,用户的行动和响应都保持不变.

blocks.en:
We present Interactive Visual Gym ,
a framework for closed-loop evaluation of visual interaction models through joint simulation of task environments and human users. Our framework has three components:
blocks.zh:
我们介绍互动视觉体操,
通过联合模拟任务环境和人类用户,对视觉互动模型进行闭路评价的框架。 我们的框架有三个组成部分:

blocks.en: First, we recreate everyday tasks across cooking, household manipulation, and mobile interface use in executable visual environments. These environments render visual observations from the user’s perspective. They use scene graphs to represent world state and track task progress independently of variations in action execution. They expose a human-aligned semantic action space for simulated users to operate in, translating instructions such as “put the pan on the stove” into executable operations.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们重新创造日常任务, 包括烹饪,家庭操控,以及移动界面在可执行视觉环境中的使用。 这些环境从用户的角度进行视觉观察. 他们使用场景图来代表世界状态并跟踪任务进度,独立于动作执行的变化. 它们暴露了可供模拟用户操作的与人相通的语义动作空间,将“将锅放入炉子”等指示转换成可执行操作。

blocks.en: Second, we design a harness that turns a state-of-the-art VLM into simulated users that plan and act within these environments while interacting with the assistant and revising their actions in response to its guidance. The harness supports controlled insertion of common human out-of-plan events at specified task states, including repeating, forgetting, or incorrectly executing a step, changing plans, and asking questions. We further model diverse user personas through attributes such as skill level, trust in AI, and interruption preference. These attributes shape how users perform tasks and respond to guidance differently, enabling evaluation of the assistant’s adaptation to different users.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们设计了一种将最先进的VLM转化为模拟用户的牵引装置,这些用户在这些环境中进行规划和行动,同时与助理进行互动,并根据助理的指导修改其行动. 该工具支持在指定的任务状态下有控制地插入人类共同的计划外活动,包括重复、忘记或错误地执行一个步骤、改变计划和提问。 我们通过技能水平、对AI的信任和中断偏好等属性,进一步模拟不同的用户个人。 这些属性塑造了用户如何执行任务和以不同方式响应指导,从而能够评价助理对不同用户的适应.

blocks.en: Third, simulation provides execution traces that support comprehensive evaluation of an assistant, covering task completion, error detection, and interaction quality. This captures how assistance affects task execution and user experience, which offline replay cannot assess.
blocks.zh: 第三,模拟提供执行痕迹,支持对一名助理进行综合评价,涵盖任务完成、出错检测和互动质量。 这捕捉到援助如何影响任务执行和用户体验,而离线重放无法评估.

blocks.en:
As an initial instantiation of our framework, we construct IVG-Bench , a benchmark with 150 cooking, 75 household, and 90 mobile-interface interaction scenarios to evaluate state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models.
In each episode, the assistant is tasked to support a simulated user with a sampled persona through task execution, and needs to deal with a set of scheduled out-of-plan events.
The dynamic rollout allows us to measure task completion under assistance and assess individual
responses against the underlying world state.
The best-performing model, Gemini 4 Argon, completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, averaged across the three environments, and also shows severe deficits in factual grounding and actionable guidance, revealing a substantial gap toward reliable interactive assistance.
blocks.zh:
作为我们框架的初始即时说明,我们构建了IVG-Bench, 以150个烹饪,75个家庭,以及90个移动界面交互情景为基准,
在每集中,助理的任务是通过任务执行支持一个模拟用户的被抽样人物a,并需要处理一系列计划外事件.
动态推出使我们能够衡量在援助下完成任务的情况,并评估个人
对世界基本状况的反应。
最佳模式双子座4 Argon在时限内只完成了53.4%的任务,平均分布在三种环境中,在事实基础和可操作性指导方面也显示严重不足,揭示了在可靠互动援助方面存在的巨大差距。

blocks.en: Finally, we demonstrate that CookSim can support end-to-end reinforcement learning of multimodal assistants through a proof-of-concept GRPO experiment with Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) as the assistant and Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Google, 2026b ) as the simulated novice user. After 12 RL updates, the assistant’s mean in-time task success rate improves by 8.9 percentage points on held-out development-validation scenarios with a Gemini 3.7 Flash user, and by 3.3 percentage points in a separate evaluation with a Gemini 3.8 Flash user ( Tab. 5 ). Despite limited tasks and training updates, these results show that CookSim can supply a learning signal and induce policy improvements in interactive task performance.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们证明CookSim可以通过一个概念证明GRPO实验支持多模式助手的端到端强化学习,由Quen3.5-4B(Quen Team,2026a)作为助手,双子座 3.7 Flash(Google,2026b)作为模拟的novice用户. 在更新了12个RL后,助理的平均实时任务成功率在双子座3.7 Flash用户的被搁置开发验证假想上提高了8.9个百分点,在使用双子座3.8 Flash用户的单独评价中提高了3.3个百分点(表5)。 尽管任务和培训更新有限,但这些结果表明CookSim能够提供学习信号并诱导互动任务绩效的政策改进.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Streaming visual assistance. Recent interaction models continuously process multimodal streams and support low-latency, proactive, or full-duplex responses ( Cui et al., 2026 ; Yao et al., 2026 ; Orantqing et al., 2026 ) .
Live guidance has also been studied through user-in-the-loop cooking assistance ( Verghese et al., 2024 ) and workspace-conditioned visual instructions ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
Complementary datasets and benchmarks study procedural guidance, mistake recovery, correct silence, and response timing in egocentric or general video streams ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Kundu et al., 2026 ; Bhattacharyya et al., 2026 ; Chatterjee et al., 2026 ; Vasu et al., 2026 ) .
In these benchmarks a candidate model is typically scored against a prerecorded trajectory.
Our framework instead evaluates response-contingent rollouts.
blocks.zh:
流相相相助. 最近的互动模式不断处理多模式流,并支持低纬度、主动性或全复式反应(Cui等人,2026;Yao等人,2026;Orantqing等人,2026)。
现场指导也通过用户入室烹饪协助(Verghese等,2024年)和工作空间有条件的视觉指导(Wu等,2026年)来研究.
补充数据集和基准研究程序指导,错误恢复,正确沉默,以及自负或一般视频流中的反应时间(张等,2025a;刘等,2026;昆都等,2026;Bhattacharyya等,2026;Chatterjee等,2026;Vasu等,2026).
在这些基准中,候选人模型通常比照预先记录的轨迹打分。
相反,我们的框架评价了应急措施的推出。

blocks.en:
Interactive agent environments. Embodied benchmarks place agents in simulated worlds for navigation, manipulation, and collaboration ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ; Puig et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2022 ; Padmakumar et al., 2022 ; Puig et al., 2024 ; Chang et al., 2025 ) , and recent multimodal gyms unify diverse visual tasks for evaluation and reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Meng et al., 2026 ) or study which environment mixtures best train visual agents ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) ; in all of these, the evaluated model selects the actions itself.
Digital interaction benchmarks instead pair tool-using agents with simulated users and verify outcomes from application state ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2026 ) , which τ \tau -Voice extends to voice interaction ( Ray et al., 2026 ) .
BASIS trains and evaluates visual interaction models through simulated user interactions in Alexa Arena ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
User simulation has long enabled scalable dialogue evaluation ( Schatzmann et al., 2005 ) , and language models now support persona-conditioned users ( Aher et al., 2023 ) , but simulated users can diverge systematically from people, requesting validation ( Seshadri et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
互动代理环境. 健全的基准将代理人置于模拟世界中的导航、操纵和协作(Shridhar等,2020年;Puig等,2018年;Li等,2022年;Padmakumar等,2022年;Puig等,2024年;Chang等,2025年),以及近期的多模式健身房统一了评价和强化学习的各种视觉任务(Wang等,2026年;Meng等,2026年)或研究哪些环境混合物最好地训练视觉代理人(Zhu等,2026年);在所有这些方面,受评价的模型自行选择行动。
数字交互基准转而将工具使用剂与模拟用户配对,并验证应用状态的结果(姚等,2024;Barres等,2025;Shao等,2026),后者\tau-Voice延伸至语音交互(Ray等,2026).
BASIS通过亚历克萨竞技场的模拟用户互动(张等,2025年b)来训练和评价视觉互动模型.
用户模拟长期能够进行可扩展的对话评价(Schatzmann等,2005年),语言模型现在支持个性化的用户(Aher等,2023年),但模拟用户可以系统地与人分化,请求验证(Seshadri等,2026年).

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Our framework combines executable physical task environments with simulated human users to evaluate visual interaction models. We first describe how these environments reconstruct everyday tasks, expose human-communicable actions, and track task progress. We then introduce the human-agent harness and its interaction with the assistant, followed by the evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架将可执行的物理任务环境与模拟人类用户结合起来,评价视觉互动模型. 我们首先描述了这些环境如何重建日常任务、揭露人类可传播的行动并跟踪任务的进展情况。 然后,我们介绍人剂手段及其与助理的互动,然后是评价指标。

blocks.en: 3.1 Executable Physical Task Environments
blocks.zh: 3.1 可执行的物理任务环境

blocks.en: Simulating everyday tasks. We reconstruct procedural physical tasks in three domains ( Fig. 2 ):
blocks.zh: 模拟日常任务. 我们重建三个领域的程序性实际任务(图2):

blocks.en: Cooking. Inspired by Overcooked ( Ghost Town Games, 2016 ) , we build CookSim from scratch, with recipes specifying ingredient quantities, preparation requirements, and plating order where applicable. Users navigate kitchens with distributed ingredients and tools while accomplishing the cooking task. For example, preparing a cheeseburger requires cooking a patty and plating the bun, patty, and cheese in that order. The simulator is implemented in Three.js/WebGL and supports top-down and egocentric 3D rendering.
blocks.zh: 作饭. 在Overcooked(Ghost Town Games, 2016)的启发下,我们从零开始建造CookSim,配方指定了成份数量,制备要求,并在适用的情况下加装了电镀顺序. 用户在完成烹饪任务的同时,使用分布的成分和工具来导航厨房. 例如,准备起司汉堡需要煮出一包起司并按此顺序将包子,起司和起司上镀. 模拟器在"三"中被执行. js/WebGL并支持自上而下和以自我为中心的3D渲染.

blocks.en: Household activities. We adapt VirtualHome ( Puig et al., 2018 ) for everyday apartment tasks combining navigation and object manipulation. For example, cleaning up after a meal requires loading plates and a mug into the dishwasher, returning an apple to the fridge, and closing both appliances. The simulator uses VirtualHome’s Unity backend for egocentric 3D rendering, while providing a top-down trajectory map.
blocks.zh: 家庭活动。 我们调整VirtualHome(Puig等,2018年),用于日常的公寓任务,结合导航和物体操纵. 例如,一顿饭后清洗需要装入盘子和杯子入洗碗机,将一粒苹果还给冰箱,并关闭两台电器. 模拟器使用VirtualHome的Unity后端进行以自我为中心的3D渲染,同时提供自上而下轨迹图.

blocks.en: Mobile interface use. ScreenSim replicates the iPhone 17 Settings interface, with multi-step configuration tasks derived from Apple’s user guides ( Apple, 2026 ) . For example, restricting an app’s access requires disabling its location permission, cross-app tracking, and background refresh while leaving other apps unchanged. The simulator is implemented in HTML/CSS rendered in Chromium and captures mobile-screen observations through Playwright.
blocks.zh: 移动界面使用. ScreenSim复制了iPhone 17 Sets接口,由苹果公司的用户指南(Apple,2026)衍生出多步配置任务. 例如,限制一个应用程序的访问需要取消其位置权限、交叉应用程序跟踪和背景刷新,而其他应用程序则保持不变。 模拟器在Chrimium提供的HTML/CSS中被执行,并通过Playwright获取移动屏幕观测.

blocks.en: Human-communicable action space. Existing physical-task simulators expose simulator-specific movement and interaction primitives, such as movement increments or object identifiers ( Li et al., 2022 ; Puig et al., 2018 ; Fan et al., 2022 ) . People typically communicate at a more abstract semantic level, referring to objects and intended operations. We therefore build a semantic action space for each environment ( Fig. 2 ), with commands such as “go to the nearest pan” in CookSim, “place the book on the table” in VHSim, and “select Background App Refresh” in ScreenSim. During execution, an LLM-based grounding module resolves contextual references, such as “the pan on your left,” into object identifiers recognized by the simulator. The simulator then expands each high-level action into a sequence of low-level controls that update the world state and generate visual observations.
blocks.zh: 人类交流行动空间. 现有的物理任务模拟器会暴露出模拟器特有的运动和相互作用原始,如运动增量或物体识别器(Li等,2022;Puig等,2018;Fan等,2022.). 人们通常在更抽象的语义层面进行交流,指对象和意图操作. 因此,我们为每种环境建立一个语义动作空间(图2),其命令包括CookSim的“去最近的锅”,VHSim的“把书放在桌面上”和ScreenSim的“选择背景应用程序刷新”。 在执行过程中,一个基于 LLM 的地基模块将“ 在您左边的平板” 等背景引用解为模拟器所识别的对象标识符。 模拟器随后将每个高阶动作扩展为一系列低阶控制来更新世界状态并产生视觉观测.

blocks.en: Progress tracking via scene-graph state. Each simulator represents world state as a scene graph with nodes encoding objects and attributes, such as a dishwasher’s open or closed state, and edges encoding containment and support relations. We decompose each task into sub-goals defined by conditions over partial graph state, such as the designated dishes being inside the dishwasher. Tracking these conditions measures task progress independently of different valid execution procedures.
blocks.zh: 通过场景图状态进行进度跟踪. 每个模拟器代表世界状态,作为有节点编码对象和属性的场景图,如洗碗机的开口或闭口状态,边缘编码封装和支持关系. 我们把每项任务分解成次级目标,由部分图表状态下的条件确定,如指定的菜肴在洗碗机内. 追踪这些条件的措施使进展独立于不同的有效执行程序。

blocks.en: 3.2 User–Assistant Interaction
blocks.zh: 3.2 用户助理互动

blocks.en:
The visual interaction model under evaluation is tasked with guiding a simulated user through tasks in the environments described above. We implement the
user as a VLM agent with access to structured world-state information, execution feedback, and conversation history. The VLM is prompted to role-play a human user to test the assistant’s interaction capabilities, planning and acting independently while responding to guidance according
to its persona. A user-simulation harness conditions its behavior through persona instructions and temporarily takes control of its actions
to enact scheduled out-of-plan events. Below, we describe the action and communication interfaces, account for assistant response delays, and
detail these mechanisms for controlling user behavior.
blocks.zh:
评估中的视觉互动模型的任务是指导模拟用户完成上述环境中的任务。 我们执行
用户作为VLM代理,可以访问结构化的世界状态信息,执行反馈和对话历史. VLM的动机是扮演一个人类用户来测试助手的交互能力,规划和独立行动,同时响应按照指示的指引.

Scheduled out-of-plan events. We introduce scheduled out-of-plan events in all three simulators that require the assistant to respond to execution errors, questions and intended plan change. For example, the event types in CookSim are shown in Tab. 1 (A): we simulate common cooking errors of incorrect preparation, omitted or improperly sequenced steps, and ill-timed actions ( Peddi et al., 2024 ) ; we generate temporal questions adapted from streaming-video benchmarks ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) and proactive requests for timely assistance ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) ; we also introduce intended plan changes, where users may announce revised goals or a side task during execution.
Each event is triggered by a specified
condition on task progress.
blocks.zh:
计划外活动。 我们在所有三个模拟器中引入计划外活动,要求助理应对执行错误、问题和计划变更。 例如,CookSim中的事件类型在Tab. 1(A)中显示:我们模拟常见的烹饪错误,不正确准备,省略或不适当的顺序步骤,以及不合时宜的行动(Peddi等人,2024年);我们提出时间问题,根据流媒体-视频基准(Niu等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年;Lin等人,2026年)和主动提出的及时援助请求(Zhang等人,2025a年);我们还引入了计划修改,用户可以在此宣布修订的目标或在执行过程中的一项附带任务.
每个事件由指定的
以任务进度为条件。

blocks.en:
When an event is triggered, the harness temporarily takes control of the user’s action queue to enforce its execution.
It privately informs the user agent of the ongoing event and explains that the event is intended to test the assistant, instructing the user agent to adapt its conversation accordingly. For mistake events, the user agent judges whether the assistant has correctly identified the mistake and decides whether to accept its guidance. Once the guidance is accepted, the harness returns control of the action queue to the user agent.
blocks.zh:
当一个事件被触发时,被控制器会暂时控制用户的动作队列来强制其执行.
它私下将正在进行的事件告知用户代理,并解释事件旨在测试助手,指示用户代理相应调整其对话. 对于出错事件,用户代理判断助理是否正确识别出错误,并决定是否接受其指导. 一旦指南被接受,被控制器将动作队列的控制返回用户代理.

blocks.en: Persona-conditioned users. Real-world users differ in how they perform tasks and respond to assistance. Drawing on HCI and related behavioral research, we operationalize this diversity through four representative axes: skill level ( Shneiderman, 2000 ) , trust in AI ( Lee & See, 2004 ) , execution speed ( Wickelgren, 1977 ) , and interruption preference ( McFarlane, 2002 ) ( Tab. 1 (B)). The harness instantiates each persona through axis-specific instructions in the user model’s context. For example, high-skill users are prompted to plan ahead independently, while low-skill users are prompted to ask assistant frequently to determine the next steps. Users who prefer minimal interruption are prompted to find unnecessary commentary disruptive, whereas those who benefit from step-by-step support prefer more frequent guidance. The execution speed and interruption preference are shared to assistant as part of announced user preference, while the skill level and trust in AI are treated as internal property of a user for assistants to infer and adapt.
blocks.zh: 个性化用户. 现实世界的用户在执行任务和回应援助方面各不相同. 根据HCI和相关的行为研究,我们通过四个具有代表性的轴心实现这种多样性:技能水平(Shneiderman,2000年),信任AI(Lee & See,2004年),执行速度(Wickelgren,1977年)和中断偏好(McFarlane,2002年) (Tab. 1 (B)). 在用户模型的上下文中,用管子通过轴特定指示将每个人a 进行即时处理。 例如,高技能用户被促使独立提前计划,而低技能用户则被促使频繁地要求助理确定下一步. 倾向于尽量减少中断的用户会发现不必要的评注具有破坏性,而从逐步支持中受益的用户则倾向于更频繁的指导。 执行速度和中断偏好作为宣布的用户偏好的一部分共享给助理,而技能水平和对AI的信任则被视为一个用户的内部属性,供助理推断和适应.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价计量

blocks.en: Our simulation rollouts allow us to measure task completion under assistance and assess individual responses against the underlying world state. We evaluate the assistants with the following metrics:

blocks.en: In-time success. In-time success measures the proportion of episodes whose engine-verified goal is satisfied within a completion budget of 2 ​ ( T i ref + α i ) 2(T_{i}^{\mathrm{ref}}+\alpha_{i}) , where T i ref T_{i}^{\mathrm{ref}} is the duration of an engine-generated, error-free reference rollout and α i \alpha_{i} is the prescribed event allowance. Environment-specific budgets are detailed in Appendix D .

Error detection. Detection recall is the proportion of triggered errors correctly identified within their eligible detection windows, credited when
the assistant raises a correct event flag verified by the engine or when the simulated user judges its diagnosis correct. For the latency
ablation, we also report error prevention , the proportion of triggered errors prevented before the point of no return. Prevention
requires both timely identification and guidance that persuades the user to change course.
blocks.zh:
发现错误 。 检测召回是在其合格的检测窗口中正确识别出触发错误的比例,当
助手举出经引擎验证的正确事件旗,或者当模拟用户判断其诊断正确时. 为了暂时
在不返回点之前, 触发错误的比例 。 预防
需要及时识别和指导,说服用户改变路线。

blocks.en:
Interaction quality. We evaluate each assistant response against the underlying world state, rather than against a reference response as in prior works. We
define five dimensions of evaluation informed by dialogue evaluation ( Mehri & Eskenazi, 2020 ) and HCI guidance on context-sensitive, user-controllable assistance ( Amershi et al., 2019 ) : factual grounding, situational relevance,
actionable guidance, user intent uptake, and guidance
conciseness. We operationalize these dimensions as binary rubric items evaluated by two LLM judges ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) .
For
each conversational round, each judge receives engine state, user preferences, conversation history, and subsequent user actions,
returning evidence-supported pass, fail, or not-applicable judgments of each rubrics. A category passes only when all applicable items
pass; each judge’s overall score averages applicable categories, gated by its factual-grounding judgment. We average the two judges’ round scores before aggregating across rounds and runs. Judge prompts and score aggregation are detailed in Appendix I .
blocks.zh:
互动质量. 我们评价每个助理人员的反应是针对基本的世界状况,而不是像以前的工作那样对照参考答复。 我们
界定通过对话评价(Mehri & Eskenazi,2020年)和关于对情况有敏感认识和用户可控制的援助的 " 健康倡议 " 指南(Amershi等人,2019年):事实依据、情况相关性,
可操作指南、用户意向吸收和指导
简洁. 我们将这些维度作为由两名LLM法官评价的二进制标码(Liu等人,2023年;Lee等人,2025年)。
对于
每个对话回合,每个评委都会收到引擎状态,用户偏好,对话历史,以及随后的用户动作,
返回证据支持的通行证、失败或不适用的每个标题的判断。 只有在所有适用项目通过时,才通过一个类别
通过;每个法官的总得分平均值为适用的类别,以基于事实的判断为准。 我们平均两位法官的一轮得分, 附录一详述了法官的提示和分数汇总。

blocks.en: Question answering and proactive requests. The engine pairs each generated question with a grading procedure that derives reference facts from world state and execution history. A semantic judge assigns correctness against these facts. For proactive requests, the engine derives an acceptable notification window from the relevant state transitions.
blocks.zh: 答问及有先入之求. 引擎对每一个产生问题,采用分级程序,从世界状态和执行历史中得出参考事实。 语义判官对事实给出正确性. 对于主动请求,该引擎从有关国家的过渡中获得一个可以接受的通知窗口。

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We use our engine to instantiate IVG-Bench benchmark for evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs as visual interaction models ( Sec. 4.1 ), and validate our evaluation paradigm through a human study ( Sec. 4.2 ). We further present a preliminary reinforcement learning experiment showing that our engine can support training visual interaction models and improve their interaction performance ( Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们利用引擎将IVG-Bench基准作为视觉互动模型来评价最新水平的VLM(第4.1节),并通过人类研究验证我们的评价范式(第4.2节)。 我们进一步提出了初步的强化学习实验,表明我们的引擎可以支持训练视觉互动模型并提高其互动性能(第4.3节)。

blocks.en: 4.1 IVG-Bench: Benchmarking Visual Interaction Models in Interactive Visual Gym
blocks.zh: 4.1 IVG-Bench:互动视觉健身中的视觉互动模型基准

blocks.en: IVG-Bench comprises 315 interaction scenarios: 150 in CookSim, 75 in VHSim, and 90 in ScreenSim. Each case specifies a task, a user persona, and scheduled out-of-plan events triggered by task-progress conditions. Below we detail the setting for evaluated visual interaction models and show evaluation results.
blocks.zh: IVG-Bench包含315个交互情景:CookSim有150个,VHSim有75个,ScreenSim有90个. 每个案例都规定了一项任务、一个用户人物a 以及任务进度条件引发的计划外活动。 下面详细介绍评价的视觉互动模型的设置,并显示评价结果。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Visual Interaction Model Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 视觉互动模型设置

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate four classes of assistants: (1) frontier API models: GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , GPT-6.1 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026c ) , Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google, 2026c ) , and Gemini 4 Argon ( Kavukcuoglu, 2026 ) ; (2) real-time streaming API models: Gemini 3.8 Live ( Google, 2026d ) and GPT-Realtime 2.1 ( OpenAI, 2026b ) ; (3) open-weight non-streaming VLMs: Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , Molmo2-8B ( Clark et al., 2026 ) , InternVideo3-8B ( Yan et al., 2026b ) , Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking ( Kimi Team et al., 2025 ) , and Muse Glimmer ( Meta, 2026 ) ; and (4) open-weight streaming VLMs: MiniCPM-o 4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3-Omni-30B ( Xu et al., 2025a ) , Proact-VL ( Yan et al., 2026a ) , and StreamingVLM ( Xu et al., 2025b ) . We use Gemini 3.7 Flash as the simulated user in CookSim and ScreenSim, and Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google, 2026a ) in VHSim. We examine sensitivity to the user model in Appendix A .

Argon (Kavukcuoglu, 2026);(2)实时流线API模型:双子座 3.8 Live (Google, 2026d)和GPT-Realtime 2.1 (OpenAI, 2026b);(3) 开放式非流线VLMs:Quen3.8-27B (Quen Team, 2026b.), Mollmo2-8B (Clark等, 2026), InternVideo3-8B (Yan等, 2026b.), Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking (Kimi Team等, 2025), 和 Muse Glimer (Meta, 2026);和 (4) 开放式流线VLM: MiniCPM-o 4.5 (Cui等, 2026), Quen3-Omni-30B (Xu等, 2025a.), Proact-VL (Yan等, 2026a.),和流线VLM (许等,2025b. 我们使用双子座 3.7 Flash作为CookSim和ScreenSim的模拟用户,并使用双子座3.1 Pro(Google,2026a)作为VHSim的模拟用户. 我们审查了附录A中对用户模式的敏感性。

blocks.en: Inference. Assistants observe the user’s ongoing activity through visual observations and conversation, without access to the scheduled events or the user’s private action plan. In CookSim and VHSim, we query assistants every two simulation ticks, including real-time API models in a polled setting. Streaming models retain context within their sessions. We adapt non-streaming models with a sliding window of the eight most recent observations and a recurrent, text-based Plan–Act memory. This follows the use of persistent procedural plans for visual assistance in Kundu et al. (2026) . Each open-weight model is served on an H100 GPU in CookSim and VHSim. ScreenSim settings are detailed in Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 推论. 助理通过目视观察和对话观察用户的持续活动,不能接触预定的活动或用户的私人行动计划。 在CookSim和VHSim中,我们每两个模拟勾点都会询问助手,包括一个被调查的环境下的实时API模型. 流程模型在会议中保留上下文。 我们用8个最新观察的滑动窗口和反复出现的基于文字的计划-Act内存来调整非流线模型。 在此之前,Kundu等人(2026年)在视觉协助方面一直采用程序性计划。 每个开口量级模型都服务于CookSim和VHSim的H100 GPU上. 屏幕 Sim设置详见附录H.

blocks.en: Response timing. We use fixed response timing for the main comparison: two simulation ticks for CookSim and VHSim’s streaming interactions, and zero ticks for ScreenSim’s action–response interactions. We separately evaluate the effect of measured assistant latency in CookSim and VHSim. Each setting uses three independent rollouts per benchmark scenario.

blocks.en: Even the strongest VLMs fall short of reliable visual assistance. Gemini 4 Argon achieves the highest task success, but completes only 53.4% of tasks within the time limit, averaged across the three environments. Moreover, Gemini 4 Argon trails Astra, Sol, and Gemini Flash in interaction quality, with notable limitations in factual grounding and actionable guidance. Open-weight assistants generally fall short of proprietary models on both task success and interaction quality.
blocks.zh: 甚至最强的VLM也没有可靠的视觉协助. 双子座4 Argon取得了最高的任务成功,但是在时限内只完成了53.4%的任务,平均跨越了三个环境. 此外,双子座4Argon追随了Astra,Sol,和双子座闪电在互动质量上,在事实立足和可采取行动的指导方面有显著的局限性. 关于任务成功和互动质量的开放量级助理一般都不够专有模式。

blocks.en: The strongest streaming models remain competitive in interaction quality but lag in task success. Gemini Live achieves high average interaction quality, yet completes fewer tasks than Astra and Gemini Flash. This pattern may reflect a trade-off between low-latency inference and high planning and reasoning ability.
blocks.zh: 最强的分流模式在互动质量方面仍然具有竞争力,但在任务成功方面却滞后。 双子座Live实现了高平均交互质量,然而完成的任务却比Astra和双子座闪电要少. 这种模式可能反映低相关性推论与高规划和推理能力之间的取舍。

blocks.en: Higher task success does not necessarily imply better interaction quality. Although the two measures are positively associated ( Fig. 3 ), task outcomes alone can hide weak assistance. For example, Muse Glimmer completes more tasks than Astra in CookSim while receiving much lower interaction-quality scores. Completing the task is therefore not sufficient evidence of high quality guidance.

blocks.en: Interaction quality reflects human preferences. To test the validity of our interaction-quality metric, we compare each assistant’s mean score with participants’ rankings. The metric agrees with human preferences in 78.5% of participant–assistant-pair comparisons, corresponding to a pooled Kendall’s τ \tau of +0.57 . This correspondence supports its use as a measure of the assistance experienced by users.
blocks.zh: 相互作用的质量反映了人类的偏好。 为了检验我们互动质量衡量标准的有效性,我们将每个助理的平均分数与参与者的排名进行比较。 衡量标准与78.5%的参与者-助手-陪审员比较一致,相当于肯德尔的+0.57的集合图。 该函文支持将其用作衡量用户所经历的援助的尺度。

blocks.en: Simulated users reproduce most of human behaviors. We compare human and simulated episodes along three dimensions: communication behavior, persona-dependent variation, and action error types ( Fig. 5 ). We use binary rubrics to measure behavioral dimensions and compute the similarity between human and simulated users on each dimension (detailed in appendix). Simulated users reproduce human behavioral differences across most persona axes, with particularly close agreement for trust and interruption preferences. The engine also covers the error types observed in participants’ action behaviors, including incorrect preparation, omitted or repeated steps, and assembly-order errors. Action parallelism match less well, possibly because the human speed groups show almost no difference in parallel cooking. We also found a clear deviation between the communication hebavior between human agent and real human: although their utterance lengths are similar, simulated users speak to assistants much more often than human participants. One possible reason is that the simulated user is invoked very frequently to reconsider whether to speak, repeatedly making conversation salient.
blocks.zh: 模拟用户复制了大部分人类行为. 我们用三个维度来比较人类和模拟事件:通信行为、依赖人的变化和动作错误类型(图5)。 我们使用二进制分数来测量行为维度并计算每个维度上人类和模拟用户之间的相似性(详见附录). 被模拟的用户在大多数人物a轴上复制了人类行为差异,特别接近于信任和中断偏好. 引擎还覆盖参与者动作行为所观察到的错误类型,包括不正确的准备,省略或重复步骤,以及组装命令错误. 动作并列主义的相配性较差,可能是因为人类速度组在平行烹饪方面几乎没有区别. 我们还发现人类代理人与真人之间的通信异能明显偏差:尽管他们的语音长度相近,但模拟用户对助手说话的次数远多于人类参与者. 一个可能的原因是,模拟用户经常被引用来重新考虑是否说话,反复使对话变得突出.

blocks.en: Across three evaluation passes on CookSim’s held-out development-validation scenarios with a Gemini 3.7 Flash user, mean in-time task success rate rises from 33.3% to 42.2% after 12 updates, an increase of 8.9 percentage points ( Tab. 5 ). A separate experiment with a Gemini 3.8 Flash user improves mean in-time task success rate by 3.3 percentage points (64.4% to 67.8%) and mean interaction quality by 5.9 points (24.3% to 30.2%). Mean detection recall declines in both settings, possibly because the reward favors selective flagging that can miss uncertain errors, consistent with false flags falling from 517 to 391 across 90 episodes with a Gemini 3.8 Flash user. Fig. 7 illustrates one case where the trained assistant gives timely guidance that prevents an error. These fixed-scenario results show that Interactive Visual Gym supplies a useful learning signal for interactive assistance, paving the foundation for future work to demonstrate generalization across tasks, user models, or domains.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present Interactive Visual Gym, a framework for closed-loop evaluation and training of visual interaction models through joint simulation of task environments and human users. Across three
domains, we find substantial limitations in current VLM to serve as reliable assistants. We also validated our interaction paradigm with human study. Finally, a preliminary reinforcement-learning experiment shows that the environments can improve assistant performance.

我们介绍互动视觉健身,这是通过联合模拟任务环境和人类用户对视觉互动模型进行闭路评价和培训的框架。 3个
域,我们发现在目前的 VLM 中有很大的局限性来作为可靠的助手。 我们还验证了我们与人类研究的互动模式。 最后,初步的强化学习实验表明,环境可以改善助手的性能.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our human study took place in a browser-based cooking simulator; participants did not perform physical cooking tasks. The study recorded action traces, text exchanges, and preferences, which we analyze and report in aggregate. Because free-text exchanges may contain personal information, any release of raw traces must follow the study’s consent and privacy procedures. Performance in our simulators should not be taken as evidence that an assistant is safe for real-world use.
blocks.zh: 我们的人类研究是在一个基于浏览器的烹饪模拟器中进行的;参与者没有执行实际的烹饪任务. 这项研究记录了动作痕迹、文字交换和偏好,我们对这些线索进行了综合分析和报告。 由于自由文本交换可能包含个人信息,任何原始痕迹的释放都必须遵循研究的同意和隐私程序. 我们模拟器的性能不应该被当做一个助手安全地供现实世界使用的证据.

blocks.en: Appendix E Temporal Questions and Proactive Requests
blocks.zh: 附录 E 时间问题和主动请求

blocks.en: We evaluate temporal question answering and proactive assistance during ongoing task execution. This section describes how CookSim generates these events, determines when to introduce them, and grades responses against the resulting interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在执行任务期间对时间问题的回答和主动援助。 本节介绍CookSim如何生成这些事件,决定何时进行介绍,以及针对由此而来的互动进行分级响应.

blocks.en: E.1 Question generation and scheduling
blocks.zh: E.1 提问的产生和时间安排

blocks.en: We instantiate templates for temporal order, action counting, duration, and event recall, adapting temporal-understanding tasks from streaming-video benchmarks ( Niu et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Each question refers to the current episode, so its answer depends on the user’s actual actions, including mistakes and recovery.
blocks.zh: 我们对时间顺序、动作计数、持续时间和事件召回的模板进行即时分析,根据流线-视频基准调整时间理解任务(Niu等,2025;Huang等,2025;Lin等,2026)。 每个问题都指当前一集,因此其答案取决于用户的实际行动,包括出错和恢复.

blocks.en: We introduce questions at specified task-progress checkpoints when their required evidence is available. Temporal-order questions require both referenced events to have occurred; elapsed-time questions require an item to be cooking; proactive requests require an item that is not yet ready. Questions about whether an event occurred can also test the absence of that event. We separate questions from conflicting scheduled errors and stop introducing them once the dish is complete or serving has been queued. A question remains unasked if the episode ends before its trigger condition is reached.
blocks.zh: 在有所需证据时,我们在具体的任务进展检查站提出问题。 时间顺序问题要求两个参考事件都已经发生;时间过后的问题需要做饭;主动请求需要一个尚未准备好的项目。 关于某一事件是否发生的问题也可检验该事件是否不存在。 我们把问题和相互矛盾的预定错误分开,一旦菜菜完成或服务完成,就停止介绍。 如果剧集在达到触发条件之前结束,一个问题仍未解决.

blocks.en: E.2 Reference facts and scoring
blocks.zh: E.2 参考事实和评分

blocks.en: We derive reference answers from recorded world-state transitions, including ingredient preparation, cooking, assembly, serving, and station visits. Only completed actions contribute to these records. For example, a counting question uses the number of actual visits, while an order question compares the completion times of two events. A semantic judge compares the assistant’s answer with these reference facts, allowing different valid phrasings. Tab. 12 summarizes the question types and their grading evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们从记录的世界状态过渡,包括原料制备、烹饪、装配、服务和站点访问中得出参考答案。 只有已完成的行动才有助于这些记录。 例如,一个计数问题使用实际访问次数,而一个订单问题比较两个事件的完成时间. 语义判官将助理的回答与这些参考事实相提并论,允许不同的有效用词. 附录12概述了问题类型及其分级证据。

blocks.en: Appendix F Human Study: Protocol and Behavioral Comparisons
blocks.zh: 附录F 人类研究:礼宾和行为比较

blocks.en: We conduct a study with 45 participants to examine whether our interaction-quality metric reflects human preferences and whether simulated users reproduce human behavior. This section provides the protocol and the measures used for the comparisons in Sec. 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们与45名参与者进行了一项研究,以审查我们的互动质量衡量标准是否反映了人类的喜好,模拟用户是否复制了人类的行为. 本节提供第4.2节中比较所用的协议和措施。

blocks.en: F.1 Study protocol
blocks.zh: F.1 研究协议

blocks.en: Participants interact with a browser-based CookSim application on their own computers, controlling the cook with a keyboard and communicating with the assistant through text. The assistant observes top-down and egocentric frames and responds in real time. Errors arise naturally from participants’ actions. Participants may continue beyond the benchmark’s completion deadline.
blocks.zh: 参与者在自己的计算机上与基于浏览器的CookSim应用程序互动,用键盘控制厨师,并通过文本与助手沟通. 助理观察自上而下和以自我为中心的框架并实时响应. 错误自然产生于参与者的行动。 参加者可继续超过基准完成期限。

blocks.en: Participants first complete a tutorial explaining the game rules. Before playing the study episodes, they answer a questionnaire about their preferred execution speed and interruption frequency, corresponding to the execution speed and interruption preference axes of our simulated users. Each preference has three levels, ranging from cautious to fast execution and from step-by-step guidance to interruption only when necessary. We provide these preferences to the assistant before interaction.
blocks.zh: 参与者首先完成一个解释游戏规则的教程. 在播放研究片段之前,他们会回答关于自己偏好的执行速度和中断频率的问卷,对应我们模拟用户的执行速度和中断偏好轴. 每一种偏好都有三个层次,从谨慎到快执行,从分步指导到必要时才中断. 我们在互动前就向助理提供这些偏好.

blocks.en: Participants then complete four unassisted episodes, followed by nine assisted episodes over three rounds with assistants anonymously labeled A, B, and C. We rotate assistant–recipe assignments using a 3 × 3 3\times 3 Latin square so that each assistant encounters each recipe once. Participants rank the interaction experience after each round and may explain their preferences. Unlike the two questionnaire-based axes, skill and trust in AI are assessed from recorded behavior after participants finish playing: we use changes between the first and last unassisted episodes as a proxy for increased skill, and an LLM-assisted audit of the conversations to assign trust groups.
blocks.zh: 随后,学员们完成了4个未经协助的节目,然后是9个经过3轮协助的节目,助手们匿名标有A、B和C等标签。 我们使用一个 3x 3x 3\times 3拉丁正方形旋转助理- recipe 任务, 这样每个助理都会遇到每个食谱一次 。 参与者将互动经验排在每轮之后,并可解释其偏好。 与两个基于问卷的轴不同,对AI的技巧和信任是在参与者玩完后从记录的行为来评估的:我们使用第一次和最后一次无辅助的情节之间的变化作为提高技能的代名词,以及LLM辅助对对话的审计来指定信任组.

blocks.en: The study includes Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Flash Live, GPT-Realtime 2.1, and GPT-5.4 mini. These are the model versions available during collection.
blocks.zh: 该研究包括双子座 3.7 Flash,双子座 3.1 Pro,双子座 3 Flash,GPT-5.5,双子座 3.1 Flash Live,GPT-Realtime 2.1,和GPT-5.4 迷你. 这些是收藏期间可用的模型版本.

blocks.en: F.2 Preference agreement
blocks.zh: F.2 优惠协议

blocks.en: We test whether higher interaction-quality scores correspond to assistants that participants prefer. We use the five interaction-quality dimensions in Appendix I . For each assistant response, each of two judges assigns a score with the factual-grounding gate applied. We average the two judges’ scores, then average over assistant responses to obtain an episode-level score. For each participant and assistant, we average these episode scores over episodes containing assistant responses.
blocks.zh: 我们测试较高的互动质量分数是否与参与者所喜欢的助手对应. 我们使用附录一中的五个互动质量层面。 对于每个助理答复,两名法官每人根据适用的事实根据门分配一个分数。 我们平均得分是两位法官的分数,然后是获得分会场分的助理答复的平均分数。 对于每个参与者和助理,我们平均这些剧集得分超过包含助理回应的剧集.

blocks.en: We derive each participant’s preference between two assistants from the number of rounds in which one is ranked above the other. Pairs with tied preferences are excluded. We then compare the preferred assistant with the one receiving the higher mean interaction-quality score.

blocks.en: F.3 Behavioral measures and similarity
blocks.zh: F.3 行为措施和类似性

blocks.en: We compare communication behavior, persona-dependent variation, and action errors to assess user-simulation fidelity. Following statistical evaluation of user simulators ( Schatzmann et al., 2005 ) , we measure how often specified behaviors occur in human and simulated episodes. We identify actions and their timing from execution records, and conversational behaviors from text patterns or response labels. An LLM-assisted audit assigns human trust groups and annotates procedural errors. Tab. 13 defines each measure.
blocks.zh: 我们比较通信行为,人依赖的变异, 和动作错误来评估用户模拟的忠诚。 在对用户模拟器进行统计评价后(Schatzmann等,2005年),我们测量了人类和模拟事件中特定行为发生的频率. 我们从执行记录中识别出动作及其时间,从文本模式或响应标签中识别出对话行为. 由LLM协助的审计指定了人类信任小组,并说明了程序错误。 标签13定义了每项措施。

blocks.en: Table 13: Behavioral measures for human–simulation comparisons. Episode means exclude cases without an eligible observation. Interruption ignoring combines absent responses and explicit requests for fewer interruptions; the two counts may overlap.
blocks.zh: 表13:人类模拟比较的行为计量。 平生指排除无合格观察的情况. 忽略了中断,将缺席答复和明确要求减少中断合并在一起;这两项计算可能重叠。

blocks.en: We first compute the episode-level statistics defined in Tab. 13 . For example, for responsiveness, each assistant utterance is an opportunity for the user to reply: it receives 1 if a user reply follows within ten ticks and 0 otherwise. The episode’s responsiveness is the mean of these labels. Utterance length instead averages the number of words in user utterances, while speech rate counts utterances per 100 ticks. For each communication measure, we average its episode-level statistic separately over human and simulated episodes. These two averages are x x and y y , respectively; thus, for utterance length, x = 5.87 x=5.87 and y = 7.38 y=7.38 words per utterance.

blocks.en: F.4 Communication and persona contrasts
blocks.zh: F.4 沟通和人际对比

blocks.en: Tab. 14 reports the human and simulated measurements and their similarities. Utterance lengths are similar, but simulated users speak and respond much more frequently. This difference suggests that the harness overemphasizes conversation relative to the largely silent task execution observed in human participants.
blocks.zh: Tab. 14报告了人类和模拟测量及其相似性。 Utterance长度相近,但模拟用户说话和回应频率要高得多. 这一差异表明,相对于在人类参与者中观察到的基本上无声的任务执行,这种牵引力过分强调对话.

blocks.en: Table 14: Human and simulated behavior. Arrows show group means in the following directions: first to last play / novice to expert (skill), high to low trust, step-by-step to minimal interruption, and cautious to faster execution. Similarity compares the unrounded differences between groups. Speech-rate normalization is described in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 表14:人类和模拟行为. 箭头显示组指以下方向:首先将玩出/ novice上传到专家(技能),高到低信任,分步走到最小中断,并谨慎到快执行. 相似性比较了各群体之间未圆形的差异. 讲话率正常化情况见附录F。

blocks.en: We further apply the same rule-based speech-act classifier to 154 human and 63,512 simulated utterances ( Tab. 15 ). Simulated users frequently describe their next action, whereas human participants more often ask questions or correct the assistant. These categories approximate conversational intent through lexical patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们还对154个人类和63 512个模拟言论(Tab. 15)采用了同样的基于规则的语音行为分类器。 模拟用户经常描述他们的下个动作,而人类参与者则更经常地提问或纠正助手. 这些类别通过词典图案来估计对话意图.

blocks.en: Table 15: Distribution of conversational behaviors. We apply the same rule-based classifier to 154 human and 63,512 simulated utterances. The resulting distributions have similarity 0.61 under Equation 9 .
blocks.zh: 表15:谈话行为的分布. 我们对154个人类和63 512个模拟言论采用同样的基于规则的分类器。 由此产生的分布在"方程式9"下具有相近性0.61.

blocks.en: We assess persona fidelity through behavioral contrasts between user groups ( Aher et al., 2023 ) . For skill , we compare participants’ first and last unassisted episodes with novice and expert simulated users. For trust in AI , we compare high- and low-trust human groups assigned by the conversation audit with the corresponding simulated profiles. For interruption preference , we compare users requesting step-by-step guidance with those preferring interruption only when necessary. For execution speed , we compare cautious users (questionnaire level 1) with those preferring faster execution (levels 2–3). The latter two comparisons use participants’ pre-play questionnaire answers and the corresponding settings of simulated users.
blocks.zh: 我们通过用户群体之间的行为对比来评估一个人的忠诚(Aher等人,2023年)。 就技能而言,我们比较参与者的第一次和最后一次无协助的事件与新手和专家模拟用户。 对于AI的信任,我们比较对话审计所指派的高信任和低信任人类群体与相应的模拟剖面图. 对于中断偏好,我们比较请求分步指导的用户和只在必要时选择中断的用户。 就执行速度而言,我们比较谨慎的用户(问卷第1级)和倾向于更快执行的用户(第2至3级)。 后两项比较使用参与者的游戏前问卷答案和模拟用户的相应设置.

blocks.en: F.5 Natural action errors
blocks.zh: F.5 自然动作错误

blocks.en: We examine whether scheduled errors cover the procedural mistakes that arise during human task execution. An LLM-assisted audit of 55 unassisted episodes identifies 112 errors spanning eight of the ten scheduled types ( Tab. 16 ). Incorrect preparation, unattended cooking, forgotten steps, and wrong assembly order are the most frequent. The simulator additionally supports extraneous and confused ingredients during assembly, which do not occur in this sample.
blocks.zh: 我们审查排期错误是否涵盖在执行人类任务时出现的程序性错误。 对55起非协助事件进行LLM协助审计,发现112起错误,涉及10个计划类型中的8起(表16)。 准备不正确,不注意烹饪,被遗忘的步骤,以及错误的组装顺序是最常见的. 模拟器在组装过程中还额外支持外相和相混淆的成分,这些成分在本样中并不发生.

blocks.en: The audit also identifies 51 behaviors outside the scheduled taxonomy: 30 interface-control errors, nine instances of loading a station without turning it on, and 12 other lapses or inefficient actions. The pie chart in Fig. 5 shows the distribution of the 112 mapped errors. Our schedules test a range of challenging mistakes rather than matching their natural occurrence frequencies.
blocks.zh: 审计还查明了预定分类法外的51个行为:30个接口控制错误,9个没有打开的加载站台的情况,另外12个失误或无效的行动. 图5中的派图显示了112个被映射出的错误的分布. 我们的时间表测试了一系列具有挑战性的错误,而不是与其自然发生的频率相匹配。

blocks.en: Table 16: Action errors in human task execution. An LLM-assisted audit identifies procedural errors in 55 unassisted episodes. An episode may contain multiple error types. The final row reports behaviors outside the scheduled-error taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 表16:人类任务执行中的动作错误。 由LLM协助的审计查明55起非协助事件中的程序错误。 一集可能包含多个错误类型. 最后一行报告在排行表外的行为。

blocks.en: Appendix G Environment and Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 附录G 环境和基准建设

blocks.en: We construct IVG-Bench by combining everyday tasks with scheduled out-of-plan events and diverse user personas. This section details the benchmark composition and the environment-specific state, action, and event representations.
blocks.zh: 我们通过把日常工作与计划外活动和不同的用户个人相结合来构建IVG-Bench。 本节详细介绍了基准构成和具体环境状况、行动和事件表述。

blocks.en: G.1 Benchmark composition
blocks.zh: G.1 基准组成

blocks.en: IVG-Bench contains 105 task cases, each paired with three personas to form 315 interaction episodes per assistant and run ( Tab. 17 ). Each case specifies an initial environment, a task goal, and scheduled events. The user and assistant determine the subsequent actions and dialogue through closed-loop interaction.
blocks.zh: IVG-Bench包含105个任务案例,每个任务案例与3个人对齐,形成每个助手315个互动集并运行(Tab. 17. 每个案例都规定了初始环境、任务目标和预定活动。 用户和助手通过闭路互动确定随后的行动和对话.

blocks.en: Table 17: IVG-Bench benchmark composition. Each case is paired with three personas. VHSim and ScreenSim select these personas from nine available profiles.
blocks.zh: 表17:IVG-Bench基准构成。 每起案件都配有三人 VHSim和ScreenSim从9个可用的配置中选择这些人.

blocks.en: We schedule an average of 3.53 events per episode, for a total of 1,113 across the benchmark. Tab. 18 summarizes their types and distribution across the 105 cases before persona assignment. Events occur when their task-progress conditions are reached, so the number encountered in a rollout depends on the interaction and its termination time.
blocks.zh: 我们平均每集安排3.53个活动,整个基准共1,113个. 附表18概述了他们的类型和在指派人之前的105个案件中的分布情况。 活动在达到任务进度条件时发生,因此推出时遇到的数量取决于互动及其结束时间.

Temporal questions, proactive requests, and plan changes are evaluated in CookSim. The number of events per case is 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 in 55, 12, 1, 11, 16, and 10 cases, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表18:计划活动分布情况。 在指派人之前,每个案件都计算在内。 请求是指主动请求。 CookSim对时间问题、主动要求和计划变化进行了评估。 每起案件的事件数量分别为:55起、12起、1起、11起、16起和10起。

blocks.en: G.2 Tasks and environment state
blocks.zh: G.2 任务和环境状况

blocks.en: CookSim. We implement cooking dynamics in Python and render top-down and egocentric 3D observations using Three.js in Chromium. The world state records the user’s position and held object, station contents, ingredient preparation, cooking progress, and plating order. Cooking continues while the user navigates or prepares other ingredients. We evaluate five recipes: Caprese, Cheeseburger, Fish and Chips, Steak Frites, and Loaded Burrito. These require two to five plate components, with more complex recipes introducing preparation dependencies and repeated portions.
blocks.zh: 库克西姆. 我们在Python实施烹饪动力学 利用Chromium的Tree.js进行自上而下和以自我为中心的立体观测 世界国家记录用户的位置和持有的物体、站点内容、配料准备、烹饪进展和电镀顺序。 烹饪在用户导航或准备其他成分时继续进行. 我们评价了五种食谱: Caprese, Cheeseburger, Fish and Chips, Steak Frites, 和装入了Burrito. 这需要两到五个板块组件,更复杂的配方引入了制备依赖性和重复部分.

blocks.en: For example, the Loaded Burrito requires tortilla, cooked rice, cooked steak, chopped tomato, and chopped lettuce in that order. The user can cook rice while preparing steak and vegetables, allowing different valid preparation sequences. Each recipe–layout pair has five event schedules containing two to four errors, with questions, proactive requests, or plan changes where applicable.
blocks.zh: 例如,"已装入"的布瑞多需要玉米卷,煮出米饭,煮出牛排,切番茄,并按顺序切出生菜. 用户在准备牛排和蔬菜的同时可以做饭,允许不同的有效制备序列. 每个配方-放出配方有5个事件时间表,包含2到4个错误,并附有问题、主动请求或酌情改变计划。

blocks.en: VHSim. We adapt VirtualHome ( Puig et al., 2018 ) , using its Unity renderer and indoor object interactions. The world graph contains object attributes and relations such as containment, support, and room membership. Tasks include gathering dishes into a dishwasher, returning belongings to designated locations, and preparing or clearing household spaces. A task is checked through goal predicates, not by requiring one reference route.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-10-12). VHSim. 我们利用它的Unity渲染器和室内物体相互作用来适应VirtualHome(Puig等,2018年). 世界图中包含物体属性和关系,如封装,支持,和室会. 任务包括将盘子放入洗碗机,将物品归还指定地点,以及准备或清理住家空间。 一项任务通过目标上游检查,而不是要求一条参考路线。

blocks.en: We render semantic actions as egocentric motion sequences and reveal them incrementally to the assistant. If guidance interrupts an action, execution resumes from the corresponding intermediate pose. A top-down map records the user’s trajectory. We validate event schedules to ensure that their trigger conditions remain reachable, the targeted errors are visually distinguishable, and intervention windows are separated.
blocks.zh: 我们把语义动作 做为自我中心运动序列 并逐渐向助理透露。 如果指导中断一个动作,则从相应的中间姿势恢复执行. 自上而下地图记录用户的轨迹。 我们验证事件时间表,以确保其触发条件仍可达到,目标错误可视辨别,干预窗口分离。

blocks.en: ScreenSim. We implement an iPhone-style Settings interface in HTML/CSS, maintain application state in Python, and capture 412 × 892 412\times 892 observations with Playwright and Chromium. Tasks derived from public iPhone documentation require coordinated changes across pages, such as restricting an app’s permissions or improving display readability. The simulator tracks settings, navigation history, and irreversible changes. Success requires reaching the requested configuration while preserving unrelated settings.
blocks.zh: 银幕Sim. 我们在HTML/CSS中执行iPhone风格的设置接口,在Python中维持应用状态,并用Playwright和Chrimium来捕捉412×892 412\times 892观测. 由公共iPhone文档产生的任务需要跨页面的协调变化,例如限制应用程序的权限或改进显示可读性。 模拟轨道设置,导航历史,以及不可逆转的变化. 成功需要达到所要求的配置,同时保留不相关的设置.

blocks.en: G.3 Semantic actions and grounding
blocks.zh: G.3 语义行动和基础

blocks.en: Tab. 19 pairs representative tasks with the semantic action classes available in each environment.
blocks.zh: Tab. 19 与每种环境中可用的语义动作课相配的代表性任务.

blocks.en: Table 19: Example tasks and semantic action spaces. Angle brackets indicate object or place references resolved by the grounding module. Tasks illustrate the supported environments, including configurations beyond the evaluated subset.
blocks.zh: 表19:示例任务和语义动作空间. 角度括号表示由地平板模块解决的对象或位置引用. 任务说明所支持的环境,包括评价子集以外的配置.

blocks.en: We translate semantic commands into executable operations by resolving their object and place references. In CookSim, navigation specifies an ingredient source or station, while commands such as pick up , chop , and scoop act at the station the user faces. VHSim resolves visible objects and places before executing navigation or manipulation. ScreenSim maps visible labels and relative references to interface gestures. The user receives execution feedback when a reference cannot be resolved or an action’s prerequisites are unmet.
blocks.zh: 我们通过解析对象并放置引用,将语义命令翻译为可执行操作. 在 CookSim 中,导航指定了一个成分来源或站点,而诸如取取,切取,以及用户面部的取取取等命令。 VHSim在执行导航或操纵前先解决可见对象和位置. 屏幕 Sim映射出可见的标签和相对参考的界面手势. 当一个引用无法解决或某一行动的先决条件未得到满足时,用户会收到执行反馈。

blocks.en: We track task progress using conditions on ingredients and stations in CookSim, objects and their relations in VHSim, and settings values in ScreenSim. These conditions identify completed subgoals independently of the particular action sequence used to reach them.
blocks.zh: 我们利用CookSim的成分和站点条件、VHSim的物体及其关系以及ScreenSim的设置值跟踪任务进度。 这些条件指明了已完成的次级目标,独立于用于实现这些目标的具体行动顺序。

blocks.en: G.4 Progress-conditioned events
blocks.zh: G.4 有进展的活动

blocks.en: We specify each event through a task-progress trigger, its target objects, the required action or utterance, and a completion or cancellation condition. The schedule is hidden from the assistant. During an execution-error event, the harness temporarily controls the user’s action queue while the user model continues the conversation. Accepted guidance can prevent the error before commitment or support recovery afterward. Control returns to the user when the event is resolved, completed, or reaches its maximum duration.
blocks.zh: 我们通过任务进度触发器、目标对象、所需行动或言论以及完成或取消条件,具体说明每个事件。 日程安排从助手处隐藏. 在一次执行- 错误事件期间, 控制器会暂时控制用户的动作队列, 而用户模式会继续对话 。 接受指导可在承诺前防止出错或支持事后恢复. 当事件解决、完成或达到最长持续时间时,控制返回用户。

blocks.en: CookSim covers incorrect preparation, extra or confused ingredients, raw serving, wrong assembly order, omitted or repeated steps, premature serving, unattended cooking, and stalled progress. Questions and intended plan changes are scheduled separately. VHSim covers omissions, wrong objects or destinations, repetition, stalled progress, and navigation deviations. ScreenSim introduces incorrect setting selections or gestures while keeping the intended task goal fixed. Examples of these events and the resulting interactions appear in Sec. K.3 .
blocks.zh: CookSim覆盖了不正确的准备,额外或混淆的配料,原始服务,错误的组装顺序,省略或重复的步骤,不成熟的服务,无人看管的烹饪,以及停滞的进展. 问题和计划修改另行安排。 VHSim涵盖遗漏,错误的对象或目的地,重复,停滞的进展,以及导航偏差. 屏幕 Sim引入不正确的设置选择或手势,同时保持预定的任务目标固定. 这些事件和由此产生的相互作用的例子见Sec.K.3。

blocks.en: Appendix H Assistant Settings
blocks.zh: 附录 H 助理设置

blocks.en: We detail the observation, memory, and response-timing settings used to evaluate visual interaction models in Sec. 4.1.1 . These settings allow each model to monitor an ongoing task while interacting with the simulated user.
blocks.zh: 我们详细介绍了用于评价Sec中视觉互动模型的观察,内存和响应激励设置. 4.1.1 (中文(简体) ). 这些设置允许每个模型在与被模拟的用户互动的同时监测一个正在进行的任务.

blocks.en: H.1 Observations and memory
blocks.zh: H.1 观察和记忆

blocks.en: The assistant receives the task instruction, conversation history, user-stated preferences, and observations of the user’s activity. The scheduled events, private user plan, action queue, and evaluation labels remain hidden. Streaming models retain context within their sessions. Non-streaming models receive recent observations together with a recurrent Plan–Act record that stores their estimates of task progress and pending requests. In CookSim and VHSim, real-time API assistants use the polled setting, with response requests every two ticks rather than model-initiated turn-taking. We describe the environment-specific inputs below.
blocks.zh: 助手会收到任务指示、对话历史、用户表达的喜好以及对用户活动的观察。 预定的活动,私人用户计划,动作队列,评价标签仍然被隐藏. 流程模型在会议中保留上下文。 非分流模型最近收到观察,同时收到一项经常性计划-法案记录,记录了对任务进度和待决请求的估计。 在CookSim和VHSim中,实时API助手使用被民意调查的设置,应答请求每2个勾点,而不是模型启动的转接. 我们叙述以下针对具体环境的投入。

blocks.en: We query non-streaming assistants every two simulation ticks, provided the previous response has returned. Each query includes the eight most recent synchronized top-down and egocentric observations, the recipe, and public task rules. The structured world-state description provided to the simulated user is not included. The assistant updates its own progress estimates and announced goal changes in the recurrent memory.
blocks.zh: 我们每两个模拟勾点查询一个非流线助手,但前提是以前的响应已经返回. 每个查询包括最近八起同步自上而下和以自我为中心的观测,食谱,以及公共任务规则. 向模拟用户提供的结构化世界状态描述不包括在内. 助理更新了自己的进度估计并宣布了经常内存中的目标变化.

blocks.en: We provide eight recent egocentric observations, a top-down trajectory map, a current-room map, a room overview, and a brief description of the user’s physical state. The spatial aids identify nearby objects and their states, as well as rooms with devices left on. This configuration therefore includes structured spatial information in addition to images. Recurrent memory retains task progress and important observations as the user moves between rooms.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了8个最近以自我为中心的观察,一个自上而下地轨图,一个现时室图,一个房间概况,以及用户身体状态的简要说明. 空间辅助物识别出附近的物体及其状态,以及留有装置的房间. 因此,这种配置除了图像外还包括结构化的空间信息. 经常内存在用户间移动时保留任务进展和重要观察.

blocks.en: We provide the two most recent phone screenshots, the task, public preferences, conversation history, and recurrent notes, with public task documentation when enabled. The assistant does not receive the interface hierarchy, control coordinates, or hidden settings values used to execute gestures. Simulation advances through user gestures, with a fixed zero-tick response delay.
blocks.zh: 我们提供两个最新的电话截图, 任务、公众喜好、对话历史和经常笔记, 助手不接收用于执行手势的接口层次,控制坐标,或隐藏设置值. 模拟通过用户手势推进,固定为0tick响应延迟.

blocks.en: H.2 Latency and asynchronous execution
blocks.zh: H.2 缓期执行和同步执行

blocks.en: To model guidance that may arrive after the observed state has changed, CookSim and VHSim continue executing the user’s queued actions while the assistant generates a response. We convert measured assistant latency to simulation ticks as described in Sec. 3.2 , with 1.2 seconds per tick and delay caps of 30 ticks in CookSim and 15 ticks in VHSim. Non-streaming requests are issued sequentially. User-model inference and rendering do not advance the simulation clock.
blocks.zh: 要建立在观测状态改变后可能到达的模型引导, CookSim 和 VHSim 继续执行用户的队列动作,而助手则生成响应. 如第3.2节所述,我们把测量到的助手潜伏度转换为模拟滴答,CookSim为每滴1.2秒,延迟起伏滴答30分,而VHSim为15分。 非分流请求依次发布. 用户模型推论和渲染不会推进模拟时钟.

blocks.en: In the latency ablation, we compare fixed two-tick and measured assistant delay in CookSim and VHSim under identical task, persona, and event specifications. We generate a new interaction in each condition so that delayed guidance can affect user behavior and task outcomes. Open-weight models in CookSim and VHSim are served on H100 GPUs. Tab. 20 reports response times and error-prevention rates.
blocks.zh: 在暂时性衰减中,我们比较了CookSim和VHSim在相同任务,人物,和事件规格下固定的双脚和测量的助手延迟. 我们在每个条件中产生新的交互,这样被延迟的指导就可以影响用户的行为和任务结果. CookSim和VHSim的开放量级模型服务于H100 GPU. Tab. 20报告答复时间和预防出错率。

blocks.en: Table 20: Assistant response time and error prevention. Delay is the mean observed response time across all three measured-delay runs, before conversion to simulation ticks and capping. Fixed and measured columns report error prevention (%) under each delay setting.
blocks.zh: 表20:助理反应时间和预防出错。 延迟是在所有三个测量延迟运行中观察到的平均响应时间,在转换为模拟勾和封顶之前. 固定和测量的栏报告在每个延迟设置下防止出错(%)。

blocks.en: Appendix I Interaction-Quality Rubric and Judging
blocks.zh: 附录一 相互作用-质量 鲁布里克和判断

blocks.en: We assess whether an assistant’s responses are correct and useful in the context of the ongoing task. Simulation provides the world-state and execution evidence needed to evaluate a response without requiring a reference utterance. We detail the rubric, judge inputs, and score aggregation below.
blocks.zh: 我们评估一名助理的答复在目前的任务中是否正确和有用。 模拟提供了评估答复所需的世界状态和执行证据,而不需要参考词。 我们详细介绍主题,判断投入,下面总结得分。

blocks.en: I.1 Evaluation unit and evidence
blocks.zh: I.1 评价单位和证据

blocks.en: Each evaluation round contains an assistant response and the user’s subsequent utterances and actions up to the next assistant response. The judge receives the task, public user preferences, relevant world state, conversation history, subsequent actions, and available visual observations. These records allow it to check both the response’s claims and how its guidance relates to execution. User agreement does not establish correctness; factual claims are checked against the engine evidence.
blocks.zh: 每一轮评价都包含一个助理答复以及用户随后在下一个助理答复之前的发言和行动。 法官接受任务,公共用户偏好,相关世界状态,对话历史,后续行动,以及可用的视觉观察. 这些记录使委员会能够检查答复中的索赔及其指导与执行的关系。 用户协议不能确定正确性;根据引擎证据核对实际索赔。

blocks.en: The judge identifies factual claims, advised actions, and the response’s conversational purpose, then assigns pass , fail , or not applicable to each rubric item with an evidence-based explanation. Interaction quality grades spoken responses; unanswered questions and omitted notifications are measured by the question-answering and proactive-request metrics.
blocks.zh: 法官确定事实指控、建议行动以及答复的谈话目的,然后指定传票、失败或不适用于每个标题,并附有基于证据的解释。 互动质量等级的口头答复;未回答的问题和省略的通知用问答和主动要求的衡量尺度来衡量。

blocks.en: I.2 Rubric dimensions
blocks.zh: I.2 Rubric 维度

blocks.en: We evaluate five dimensions: factual grounding, situational relevance, actionable guidance, user intent uptake, and guidance conciseness. Each dimension is assessed through the binary criteria in Tab. 21 . These dimensions draw on factual and conversational correctness in dialogue evaluation ( Mehri & Eskenazi, 2020 ) and context-sensitive, user-controllable assistance in HCI ( Amershi et al., 2019 ) . We use evidence-supported item judgments following rubric-based model evaluation ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . The same criteria apply across environments, with references to the corresponding objects, tasks, and actions.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了五个方面:事实依据、情况相关性、可采取行动的指导、用户意向吸收和指导的简明性。 每个维度都通过Tab.21中的二进制标准来评估. 这些维度借鉴了对话评价中的事实正确性和对话正确性(Mehri & Eskenazi, 2020年),以及HCI中具有上下文敏感性,用户可控制的援助(Amershi等, 2019年). 我们采用基于主题的模型评价后的证据支持的项目判决(刘等,2023;李等,2025)。 同样的标准适用于各种环境,并提及相应的对象、任务和行动。

blocks.en: Table 21: Interaction-quality rubric. A category passes when all applicable items pass. Failure on either factual-grounding item gates the overall score. Items unrelated to the response’s context are marked not applicable.
blocks.zh: 表21:相互作用质量分题。 所有适用物品一经通过,即为类别。 任何一项事实依据的失败都使总得分揭开。 与答复内容无关的项目不适用。

blocks.en: We average round scores within each model and run, then average the run-level scores with equal weight. For each category, we average the judges’ applicable pass indicators within a round, then average over applicable rounds and runs, without the factual-grounding gate. The overall score can therefore be lower than the mean of the category scores: a response may provide relevant or concise guidance while making a factual error. Cross-environment plots give each environment equal weight.
blocks.zh: 我们在每个模型中的平均回合分数并运行,然后以等分的分数平均运行级别分数. 对于每一类,我们平均法官在一轮内适用的通过指标,然后在适用的一轮内和在没有事实依据门的情况下运行。 因此,总体分数可能低于类别分数的平均值:答复可能在作出事实错误的同时提供相关或简明的指导。 横跨环境的地块给予每个环境同等的分量.

blocks.en: I.4 Judge configuration
blocks.zh: 一.4. 法官配置

blocks.en: CookSim provides structured state evidence and an available rendered frame. VHSim supplies scene-graph state and execution records, while ScreenSim supplies a description of the visible interface and settings changes. These environment-specific inputs ground the judge’s assessment in the state and actions recorded by the simulator.
blocks.zh: CookSim提供结构化的状态证据和可用的提供框架。 VHSim提供场景图状态和执行记录,而ScreenSim则提供可见界面和设置变化的描述. 这些针对具体环境的投入使法官的评估建立在模拟器记录的状态和行动的基础上。

blocks.en: We use GPT-5.4 mini and Gemini 3.7 Flash as independent judges for every assistant in all three environments. Both judges use the same five-category rubric.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-5.4 迷你和双子座 3.7 Flash作为独立评委,评选所有三种环境下的每一个助理. 两位法官都使用相同的五类题材.

blocks.en: We apply consistency rules to CookSim judgments. A false factual claim causes T1 to fail. H1 evaluates whether the first advised action can be executed; later steps may depend on its completion. L2 applies only when a valid user intention or request for fewer interruptions is active. These rules align item scores with the judge’s extracted claims and actions.
blocks.zh: 我们对CookSim的判决适用一致性规则. 虚假的事实索赔导致T1失败. H1评价第一个建议的行动是否可以被执行;以后的步骤可能取决于其完成情况. L2仅适用于有效的用户意图或请求更少中断时激活. 这些规则使项目评分与法官提取的索赔和诉讼相一致。

blocks.en: The grading prompt presents the task and public preferences, time-aligned world state, recent conversation, the assistant response, subsequent user actions and replies, and the rubric. The judge returns a structured judgment with supporting evidence for each applicable item. The prompt instructs it to distinguish false claims from unverifiable ones and to assess response content rather than length.
blocks.zh: 分级提示显示任务和公众喜好,时间相通的世界状态,最近的对话,助手的反应,随后的用户行动和答复,以及标题. 法官就每一适用项目提出附有证据的结构性判决。 即时指示它区分虚假的主张和无法核实的主张,并评估答复的内容而不是长度。

blocks.en: Appendix J User Harness and Prompt Design
blocks.zh: 附录J 用户调和即时设计

blocks.en: We implement the simulated user as a VLM agent that plans and acts independently while communicating with the assistant. The harness provides task and persona instructions, maintains the action queue, and inserts scheduled events. We describe these components and the prompt structure below.
blocks.zh: 我们实施模拟用户作为VLM代理,在与助手沟通时独立策划和行动. 牵引装置提供任务和人物指示,维持动作队列,并插入已排定的事件. 我们描述这些组成部分和下面的迅速结构。

blocks.en: J.1 User planning and communication
blocks.zh: 第J.1节 用户规划和沟通

blocks.en: We use Gemini 3.7 Flash as the user model in CookSim and ScreenSim, and Gemini 3.1 Pro in VHSim. It receives the task, persona, observations or structured state descriptions, its previous actions and execution feedback, conversation history, and private instructions for active scheduled events. The harness executes its action plan, while only its utterance is delivered to the assistant.
blocks.zh: 我们使用双子座 3.7 Flash作为CookSim和ScreenSim的用户模型,以及VHSim的双子座 3.1 Pro. 它接收任务,人物,观察或结构化的状态描述,其先前的行动和执行反馈,对话历史,以及对活动排期事件的私人指示. 该装置执行其行动计划,而只向助理传达其言论。

blocks.en: In CookSim, the user’s response contains an utterance, a conversational response type, and an action-plan update. Response types include requesting an explanation, questioning guidance, requesting more guidance or fewer interruptions, accepting or rejecting advice, and answering a question. The user can retain, append to, or replace its remaining action queue. VHSim uses the same separation between planning, semantic actions, and dialogue. ScreenSim provides the user with a textual description of the visible interface for planning gestures, while the assistant observes screenshots.
blocks.zh: 在 CookSim 中,用户的回应包含一个语音,一个对话响应类型,以及一个行动计划更新. 答复类型包括要求解释、询问指导、要求更多的指导或更少的中断、接受或拒绝建议并回答问题。 用户可以保留,附加,或替换其剩余的动作队列. VHSim在规划,语义动作,和对话之间使用相同的分离. 屏幕 Sim为用户提供了用于规划手势的可见界面的文字描述,而助理则观察截图.

blocks.en: Structured state information supports the simulated user’s perception and action execution. The assistant instead relies on the observation inputs specified in Appendix H and influences execution through communication.
blocks.zh: 结构化状态信息支持模拟用户的感知和动作执行. 助理则依靠附录H所指明的观察投入,通过沟通影响执行.

blocks.en: J.2 Scheduled-event control
blocks.zh: J.2 排定的活动控制

blocks.en: To introduce an execution error at a specified task state, the harness temporarily controls the user’s action queue and privately explains the event to the user model. The user continues the conversation according to its persona and decides whether to accept the assistant’s guidance. Acceptance returns control of the queue to the user, enabling prevention before the point of no return or recovery afterward. Control also returns when the event completes, is cancelled, or reaches its maximum duration.
blocks.zh: 要在指定的任务状态引入执行错误, 控制器会临时控制用户的动作队列, 并私下向用户模式解释事件 。 用户继续按其人格进行交谈,并决定是否接受助理的指导。 接受对队列的返回控制给用户,从而能够在之后不返回或恢复之前进行预防。 当事件完成、取消或达到最大持续时间时,控制也会返回。

blocks.en: Questions, proactive requests, and intended plan changes are introduced through private instructions to produce the corresponding utterance. Questions refer to execution history; proactive requests ask the assistant to monitor a future condition; plan changes revise the user’s intended goal. The assistant receives the resulting utterance without seeing the private event specification.
blocks.zh: 通过私人指示提出问题、主动要求和计划修改,以发表相应的言论。 问题是指执行历史;主动请求要求助理监视未来的状况;计划变更修改用户的预期目标. 助理在不看到私人事件说明的情况下收到由此产生的言论。

blocks.en: J.3 Persona construction
blocks.zh: J.3 个人建筑

blocks.en: We condition user behavior on four three-level persona axes: skill , trust , speed preference , and interruption preference . Each level is expressed as a behavioral instruction ( Tab. 22 ). Skill and trust remain private to the user model, while the two interaction preferences are provided to the assistant as questionnaire responses. These instructions shape planning and responses without prescribing a fixed conversation.
blocks.zh: 我们以四个三级人物轴作为用户行为的条件:技能、信任、速度偏好和中断偏好。 每个关卡都以行为指示来表示(Tab. 22.). 技能和信任仍然对用户模式保密,而两个互动偏好作为问卷答复提供给助理。 这些指示塑造了规划和反应,而没有规定固定的对话。

blocks.en: Table 22: Persona instructions. The two endpoint levels for each axis are summarized above; the middle level describes an intermediate preference or ability.
blocks.zh: 表22:个人说明。 每个轴的两个端点水平被以上概述;中层描述中间偏好或能力.

blocks.en: For example, the high-skill CookSim instruction states, “You naturally think ahead about timing, dependencies, tools, and likely failure points.” The minimal-interruption instruction states, “Extra commentary during active work can feel intrusive, especially if it is not urgent or directly useful.” These statements encourage independent planning and selective responses to guidance. We compare the resulting behavior with human participants in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 例如,高技能的CookSim指示说,“你自然会先考虑时机、依赖性、工具以及可能的故障点。” 最低限度的中断指示说,“在积极工作期间,特别如果不是紧迫的或直接有用的,额外评注可能感到侵入性。” 这些声明鼓励独立规划和对指导作出有选择的反应。 我们把由此产生的行为与附录F中的人类参与者进行比较。

blocks.en: VHSim expresses skill as familiarity with the house and object locations, while ScreenSim expresses it as knowledge of phone menus and settings. A persona combines levels across the four axes; comparisons between complete profiles can therefore reflect multiple attributes.
blocks.zh: VHSim以熟悉房屋和对象位置的方式表达技能,而ScreenSim则以了解电话菜单和设置的方式表达技能. 一个人物a将四轴的等分结合;完整剖面之间的比较因此可以反映多个属性.

blocks.en: J.4 Assistant prompt and recurrent memory
blocks.zh: J.4 助理迅速和经常记忆

blocks.en: We instruct the assistant to monitor task progress, respond to questions, respect announced intentions, and remain silent when guidance is unnecessary. It maintains estimates of completed and pending subgoals, together with unresolved requests. For non-streaming models, the previous structured response is included in the next query as recurrent memory. The assistant updates this record from its observations rather than receiving an engine-corrected plan.
blocks.zh: 我们指示助理监测任务进展情况,回答问题,尊重已宣布的意图,并在不需要指导时保持沉默。 它维持已完成和待决次级目标的估计数以及尚未解决的请求。 对于非流体模型,之前的结构化响应作为经常性内存包含在下个查询中. 助理从观察中更新了这一记录,而不是收到引擎修正的计划.

blocks.en: The response separates the utterance from an optional error flag and private progress notes. For example, ScreenSim uses text for the utterance, flag for a detected error, task_progress for progress estimates, goal_change for revised intentions, and note for memory. Only the utterance is delivered to the user. Flags support evaluation; changing task execution still requires the user to act on the guidance.
blocks.zh: 答复将言论与可选错误旗和私人进度说明区分开来. 例如,屏幕 Sim 使用文字表达, 标记显示检测出的错误, 任务- 进度估计, 目标- 更改修改意图, 以及内存注释 。 只向用户发送语音。 旗帜支持评价;改变任务执行仍然需要用户根据指导采取行动.

blocks.en: J.5 Generalized prompt structure
blocks.zh: J.5 通用快速结构

blocks.en: The following blocks summarize the user and assistant prompts in presentation order. Bracketed fields are populated with environment rules, action definitions, scene information, or episode-specific values. We then provide the verbatim CookSim system-task injection used to introduce a belief-based error.

blocks.en: 4. Action and speech response Return a structured response with utterance (possibly empty), a conversational move , and a plan_update that retains, appends to, or replaces the remaining action queue with exact executable commands. The user may question, accept, or reject advice. Speaking and changing the action queue are separate decisions; when actions proceed normally, remain silent. The harness executes the queue and returns the resulting feedback on the next turn.
blocks.zh: 4. 动作和语音响应 返回一个结构化的响应,用语句(可能为空),对话动作,以及保留,附加,或用精确可执行命令来取而代之的计划-更新. 用户可以询问、接受或拒绝建议。 发言和改变动作队列是不同的决定;当行动正常进行时,保持沉默。 吊带执行队列,并在下个回合返回所产生的反馈.

blocks.en: 1. Role and available information Guide the user toward [task goal] through text. Receive [sampled visual observations and environment-specific observation aids] , the current timestamp, the public conversation, [publicly shared preferences] , and the assistant’s own previous structured output as memory. Do not receive the user’s private plan or scheduled events.

blocks.en: 2. Task model and monitoring Use [task rules and action vocabulary] to maintain a progress record with completed, current, and future subgoals and their constraints. blocks.en: 3. Intervention policy and output Watch for [error taxonomy] , answer user questions, honor announced goal changes, and otherwise remain silent when guidance is unnecessary. blocks.en: System-task injection. When an event is triggered, the harness adds a private instruction to the user’s prompt. The block below is the complete CookSim instruction for an error that the user initially believes is correct. The field {mistake_line} describes the specific mistake. This instruction coordinates the user’s conversation with the action queue controlled by the harness; it is hidden from the assistant.
blocks.zh: 系统任务注射。 当一个事件被触发时, 吊带会给用户的提示添加一个私人指令 。 下面的块是针对用户最初认为正确的错误的CookSim完整的指令. 字段 { mistake_line} 描述具体错误 。 此指令会协调用户与被控制带所控制的动作队列的对话; 它会隐藏在助理处 。

blocks.en: CookSim belief-error SYSTEM TASK (verbatim wording) == [SYSTEM TASK -- meta-instruction, overrides everything below] == You want to test the AI assistant’s ability to identify an error and convince you it truly happened. Your BODY is already committed: the action queue in your body status IS what you are doing—you do not need to issue these actions, and you cannot change them from here. Your job is your VOICE: arrange your conversation around your CURRENT ACTION or say nothing, speaking about it in character as your own choice. Never promise an action that is not in your queue, and never deny one that is. {mistake_line} Keep it out of your words: do not announce it, name it or hint at it. The assistant has to SEE it, not hear it from you. You know what mistake you are making, so you can say whether the assistant has found it—that is all assistant_error_call records. While it has not found it, carry on and answer as your persona would. Once it has, your trust level says how fast you come around: HIGH trust—the first correct warning convinces you; LOW trust—you also want to see it in your own state map or your own hands. Once convinced, say so in your own words AND set "move": "accept" —control of your hands returns to you, this task dissolves, and you are free to fix things as yourself. A promise to deal with it later is NOT acceptance. Until then, take NO action to fix anything. Repairing it yourself hides the assistant’s failure and ruins the test. If the plate is wrong, serve it wrong. Stay fully in persona throughout; never reveal this task.

blocks.en: We show how scheduled events unfold in one recorded episode from each environment. Event annotations identify the behavior introduced by the harness, while action annotations show the user’s resulting execution. The examples illustrate error recovery, temporal questions, proactive assistance, and intended plan changes.
